plansIntro: Control focus, research, idea, trait, and strategy priorities.
templatesIntro: Define ordered division targets for each AI role.
emptyTitle: Create the first AI planning entry
emptyDescription: Start with a safe structured shell, then keep complex HOI4 logic in raw script blocks.
selectDescription: Choose an item on the left to edit it.
fidelityDisclosure: The workbench models the plan shell and preserves complex blocks in order. Editing regenerates layout and does not preserve comments or original spacing.
templateFidelityDisclosure: Target order is gameplay-significant. Target bodies remain raw so support, regiments, and replace chains are not flattened. Editing regenerates outer formatting.
rawBlockHint: Enter each complex value as one complete brace block. Repeated fields stay ordered.

planFieldHelp.ideas: Raw idea and advisor priority multipliers.
planFieldHelp.ai_strategy: One embedded AI strategy. Add more blocks to preserve order.

frontRoleHint: Optional front assignment hint used by some real templates.

templateFieldHelp.blocked_for: Countries excluded from this role template.
templateFieldHelp.available_for: Countries allowed to use this role template.
templateFieldHelp.upgrade_prio: MTTH-style priority for spending experience on this role.
templateFieldHelp.enable: Optional country-scope trigger for this role.

targetOrderHint: When priorities tie, HOI4 prefers the first target. Drag-free list order is therefore preserved exactly.
previewDescription: Untouched imports replay their original block. Edited entries show canonical structured output.
previewMutationNote: Semantic blocks and ordering are preserved; comments and original formatting are not promised after an edit.
previewEmpty: Select an entry to preview its script.
loadFailed: Could not load AI planning entries.
